PK_SNAPSHOT_ERRORS.rule: codes never recycled; retired codes move to RESERVED

rules.additive: new optional fields -> minor bump; readers MUST reject unknown fields at trust boundaries, so a new field is only sent to peers that advertise the new minor
rules.breaking: any removed/renamed/re-typed field or changed semantics -> major bump; old major refused with SNAP_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION before state mutation
rules.security_downgrade: never negotiated: encryption, tenant binding, grant requirement, entropy ack are LOCKED config invariants
rules.old_snapshots: a snapshot is restorable only with the same VMM major, arch and device fingerprint; otherwise re-capture (no migration of VMM state files)
rules.downgrade: package downgrade within the same interface majors is supported; across a major, metadata export/import (BACKUP_RESTORE.md) + re-capture

pk_core.note: required only by contract.py/component.py; distribution/version/digest unknown -> not pinned to a guess (X013 BLOCKED_EXTERNAL)
